title: World Country Book — Country Record
description: One record drives one A3 spread. Counts are FIXED and char limits reliably fit the page; the overflow=0 page check is the final authority.

name.description: Display name, UPPERCASE. ≤9 chars sits at 70px; shrink font for longer.

nativeName.description: Native-script glyph(s) for the emblem disc, e.g. 日本. If Latin/long, may repeat name.

tagline.description: Nickname, e.g. 'Land of the Rising Sun'.

langName.description: Language shown in the phrasebook tick, e.g. 'Japanese', 'Aussie English'.

stop.description: Position in the around-the-world series (Explorer's Log stamp).

titleSize.description: Optional masthead font-size override (px) for long names. Default 70; e.g. AUSTRALIA uses 50.

layout.description: Which spread template renders this country. ROTATE across the book — never give a whole continent/region the same layout. See README 'Palette × Layout rotation'.

motif.description: Signature decorative ribbon under the header. Pick one that suits the country's visual culture (add new ones as needed). Distinct from layout.

theme.description: Per-country palette, applied via CSS variables. Keep the warm field-journal family (low-chroma paper, dark warm ink); the two accents come from the flag.

paper.description: Page background — a country-specific warm tint (sand, parchment, ochre…). e.g. '#F2E4BD'.

dot.description: Background dot-grid colour, ~1 step darker than paper.

ink.description: Primary text colour — a dark, warm near-black tuned to the paper.

accent.description: PRIMARY flag-derived colour: spine, data-bar, section rules, drop-cap, WOW numbers, myth border, stamp. e.g. '#C0202E'.

accent2.description: SECONDARY flag colour used in the motif ribbon (and free for layout accents). e.g. '#23406b'.

assetPath.description: Path to a real flag SVG (flag-icons / Wikimedia PD). Trivial geometric flags MAY be CSS-drawn instead.

note.description: e.g. 'a red sun on white · official since 1999'.

keyColor.description: Hex of the flag's dominant color; feeds the 'sun'/emblem token. e.g. '#BC002D'.

mastheadMotif.description: How the circular masthead disc is derived per country.

facts.description: Exactly 6, in order: Capital, People, Money, Language, Land area, Highest point.

islands.description: Major regions/islands/states for the chip row. Relabel the heading per country.

sections.description: Per-country flavor titles for the 6 SecHeads (all NOWRAP, ≤30 chars).

geo.description: colBreak — keep the two paragraphs roughly equal.

myths.description: Mandatory myth-busting feature: exactly 2 popular myths + gentle corrections.

photos.description: 4 Creative-Commons landscape photos, subject clearly centered. Self-host in production + attribute.

src.description: Self-hosted asset path. Landscape, ≥1600px long edge.

caption.description: Mono caption; lead with the SUBJECT in caps.
